declared.title: Even Einstein struggled: Effects of learning about great scientists’ struggles on high school students’ motivation to learn science.
declared.foundIn: Crossref search « Even Einstein struggled effects of learning about great scientists struggles on high school students motivation » (2026-11-26); named by the counter-evidence review

population: 402 9th and 10th grade students, demographically diverse; stories of scientists' struggles vs stories of their discoveries; country not given in the abstract

findings.text: Students who read about great scientists' struggles, intellectual (their mistakes) or personal (hardship), before their success later learned science better than students who read only about their achievements

support.sentence: Results showed that participation in either of the struggle story conditions improved science learning postintervention, relative to that of students in the control condition.

findings.text: The gain was larger for low-performing students

support.sentence: Additionally, the effect of our intervention was more pronounced for low-performing students.

limits: one study by the team that designed the stories; random assignment and its level (student or class) not stated in the abstract (full text not read)
`experiment` is provisional: if whole classes received one condition, it is a quasi-experiment
the outcome is science learning in class, through motivation, not learning the content of the failures; the measure of science learning is not given in the abstract
the personal-hardship stories, with no failure in them, had the same effect: what helps is struggle overcome or feeling close to the scientists, not failure
no effect size in the abstract; every struggle story ends in success
